verses.text: Wine makes people mock, and beer makes them start fights. Whoever is led astray by drink is not wise.
A king's anger is like the roar of a lion. Whoever makes him angry puts their own life at risk.
It is to a person's honour to avoid arguments, but every fool is quick to quarrel.
Lazy people do not plough in autumn, so at harvest time they look for food and find nothing.
The plans in a person's heart are like deep water, but someone with understanding can draw them out.
Many people claim to be loyal, but who can find someone who is truly faithful?
Good people live honest lives. Their children after them are blessed.
When a king sits on his throne to judge, he sees through evil and scatters it.
Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure. I am clean and free from sin"?
The LORD hates dishonest weights and dishonest measures.
Even children show what they are like by what they do, whether their actions are pure and right.
Ears that hear and eyes that see, the LORD made them both.
Do not love sleep, or you will become poor. Keep your eyes open, and you will have plenty of food.
"It's no good, it's no good!" says the buyer. Then he goes off and boasts about his bargain.
There is gold and plenty of rubies, but words of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Take the coat of someone who guarantees a stranger's debt. Hold it as security if he does it for a woman he does not know.
Food gained by cheating tastes sweet at first, but later it is like a mouth full of gravel.
Make plans by asking for advice. If you go to war, get good guidance.
A gossip tells secrets, so avoid people who talk too much.
If someone curses their father or mother, their lamp will go out in total darkness.
An inheritance gained too quickly at the start will not be blessed in the end.
Do not say, "I will pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the LORD, and he will rescue you.
The LORD hates dishonest weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.
The LORD directs a person's steps. So how can anyone understand their own way?
It is a trap to make a promise to God too quickly and only think about it afterwards.
A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them.
The human spirit is the LORD's lamp. It searches out the deepest parts of a person.
Faithful love and truth keep a king safe. His throne is made secure by faithful love.
The glory of young men is their strength. The beauty of old men is their grey hair.
Blows and wounds wash away evil, and beatings clean the deepest parts of a person.
